title: India's one clock in 15 seconds
subject: time zones

concept.logline: One country, one clock, and a Sun that rises two hours apart.
concept.central_question: Why does the sun rise at 4 a.m. in one corner of India?
concept.claim: India keeps one clock across two hours of sunlight; its own timekeepers proposed two.

scenes.narration: In June, the sun rises over Arunachal before 4:30 a.m.

scenes.narration: In Gujarat, it stays dark for two more hours.
